subject: Plan for Redwood intro — proposal to split into quick intro + technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Ross <avery.ross@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Feb 2026 16:00:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood intro — proposed times and agenda

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the interest — excited to connect. I can do an introductory demo next week to walk through the product surface and show how Redwood would fit into Nimbus Retail's search/recommendation roadmap. Proposed slots (PST):

- Tue Feb 10, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Feb 11, 14:00–14:45

Agenda (45m):
- 10m: Context and goals you shared
- 20m: Live demo of relevant flows (search/re-rank + embeddings example)
- 10m: Next steps / mutual action plan

Marissa (CS) and Karthik (solutions) are looped in — they can join the session or we can schedule a follow-on technical deep-dive if you prefer a hands-on scoping workshop. I attached a short agenda and will follow up with a calendar invite once we land a time.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Avery Ross <avery.ross@nimbusretail.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jin Park <jin.park@nimbusretail.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood intro — proposed times and agenda

Hi Dylan — thanks for the options. Wed 14:00 PST works best for our team. A quick note: our Head of Engineering (Jin) is traveling on Wed afternoon and would like a more technical session with your engineers. Would it be possible to: 1) keep Wed 14:00 as a 30–40m product intro for the exec/stakeholders; and 2) schedule a separate 90–120m engineer-to-engineer deep-dive the following week when Jin is back?

If that works, book the short intro with the stakeholders and then we can coordinate dates for the technical workshop. Also, can you include a short outline for the deep-dive so our infra team can review?

Thanks,
Avery
Director, Product Partnerships
Nimbus Retail
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Ross <avery.ross@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood intro — proposed times and agenda

Perfect — thanks for the heads up, Avery.

We can absolutely do a split approach: a compact 30–40m executive/demo session this Wed at 14:00 PST, and then a follow-up technical scoping workshop (90–120m) the week after. Draft plan for the technical deep-dive (attached):

- 15m: scoping & success metrics (you + infra owner)
- 30m: architecture review (data, telemetry, storage, VPC/KMS needs)
- 30m: live POC run / model selection discussion (sample workloads)
- 15m: rollout & reliability discussion (SLOs, autoscaling, fallbacks)

Marissa will run the short intro on Wed. Karthik and I will be available for the technical workshop — we propose Tue Feb 17 or Thu Feb 19, morning PST.

I'll send the calendar invites now (intro invite will be 30m) and attach the workshop outline. If Jin or your infra team want a pre-read, I'll also share our checklist and a sample architecture doc.

—Dylan

Attachments: tech-workshop-outline.pdf, NR-Intro-Agenda.pdf
From: Jin Park <jin.park@nimbusretail.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Ross <avery.ross@nimbusretail.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood intro — proposed times and agenda

Thanks — confirmed for Wed 14:00 PST for the short intro. For the deep-dive, Thu Feb 19 morning PST would be better for me (I land late Tue night).

Also two asks for the workshop pre-read:
1) sample token-cost estimate for a 10k QPS routing pattern (ballpark numbers are fine)
2) a short note on networking requirements for private deployments (VPC peering and KMS options)

If you can include those in the pre-read, we can shorten the architecture slot and spend more time on POC data setup.

-Jin
Head of Engineering, Nimbus Retail
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jin Park <jin.park@nimbusretail.com>, Avery Ross <avery.ross@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood intro — proposed times and agenda

Great — Wed intro confirmed, Thu Feb 19 at 09:30 PST reserved for the technical deep-dive. Calendar invites sent (30m intro, 120m deep-dive). Pre-read and cost/networking notes attached (see tech-workshop-outline.pdf and the cost-estimate slide in the Drive link).

Quick logistics:
- Intro (Wed 14:00 PST): Marissa will demo; it's stakeholder-facing — please share any specific demo focus areas if you want us to prioritize (e.g., re-rank, personalization, cold-start workflows).
- Deep-dive (Thu 09:30 PST): engineering-level; we'll bring a small infra checklist and sample POC repo.

If anything changes on your side (travel delays or additional attendees), let me know and we can split the deep-dive into two 60m sessions, but I think keeping it contiguous will be most effective. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: demo-calendar-invite.ics
